text:
Tabligh mein Sabr-o-Zabt ki Ahmiyat

Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko tasalli dete hue farmata hai ke kuffar jo aap ko kehte hain woh koi nayi baat nahi, un se pehle ke kafiron ne bhi apne apne zamane ke rusolon se yahi kaha hai. Kafiron ka yeh qaul silsila-ba-silsila yunhi chala aaya hai jaise aapas mein ek dusre ko wasiyat kar ke jata ho. Sach toh yeh hai ke sarkashi aur sartabi mein yeh sab yaksaan hain, is liye jo baat pehle walon ke munh se nikli wahi in ki zubaan se nikalti hai kyunke sakht dili mein sab ek se hain. Pas aap chashm-poshi kijiye, yeh majnoon kaheen, jadugar kaheen, aap sabr-o-zabt se sun len haan naseehat ki tabligh na chhoriye, Allah ki baatein pehchante chale jaiye. Jin dilon mein iman ki qubuliyat ka mada hai woh ek na ek roz rah par lag jayenge.

Phir Allah Ta'ala Jalla Jalaluhu ka farman hai ke main ne insanon aur jinoon ko kisi apni zarurat ke liye nahi paida kiya balki sirf is liye ke main unhein un ke nafe ke liye apni ibadat ka hukm dun, woh khushi na-khushi mere ma'bud-e-barhaq hone ka iqraar karein, mujhe pehchanein. Hazrat Suddi farmate hain: Baaz ibadatein nafa deti hain aur baaz ibadatein bilkul nafa nahi pohnchati hain, jaise Quran mein ek jagah hai ke agar tum in kafiron se pucho ke asman-o-zamin ko kis ne paida kiya hai? To yeh jawab denge ke Allah Ta'ala ne. Toh go yeh bhi ibadat hai magar mushrikon ko kaam na aaye gi. Gharaz abid sab hain khwah ibadat un ke liye nafi ho ya na ho. Aur Hazrat Zahak farmate hain: Is se murad musalman insan aur iman wale jinnaat hain.

Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood farmate hain ke mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ ne yun parhaya hai hadith: (Innal-laha huwar-razzaqu dhul-quwwatil-mateen - 58) (Ad-Dariyat: 58). Yeh hadith Abu Dawood, Tirmizi aur Nasai mein bhi hai, Imam Tirmizi ise Hasan Sahih batate hain.

Gharz Allah Ta'ala ne apne bandon ko bandagi ke liye paida kiya hai ab uski ibadat yaksu-e-ke sath jo baja layega kisi ko uska sharik na karega woh use puri puri jaza inayat farmayega aur jo uski na-sufarmani karega aur uske sath kisi ko sharik karega woh bad-tareen sazayein bhugtega Allah kisi ka mohtaj nahi balki kul makhlooq har haal aur har waqt mein uski puri mohtaj hai balki mahz be-dast-o-pa aur sarasar faqir hai khaliq razzaq akela Allah Ta'ala hi hai, Musnad Ahmad mein Hadith-e-Qudsi hai ke "Ae Ibn-e-Adam meri ibadat ke liye farigh hoja main tera seena tongari aur be-niyazi se bhar dunga aur teri faqiri rok dunga aur agar to ne aisa na kiya toh main tere seene ko ashghal se bhar dunga aur teri faqiri ko hargaz band na karunga" Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh hadith-e-shareef hai, Imam Tirmidhi isse Hasan Ghareeb kehte hain. 

Khalid ke dono larke Hazrat Habba aur Hazrat Sawa Razi Allahu Anhum farmate hain hum An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue us waqt Aap kisi kaam mein mashghool the ya koi deewar bana rahe the ya kisi cheez ko durust kar rahe the hum bhi usi kaam mein lag gaye jab kaam khatam hua toh Aap ne hamein dua di aur farmaya "Sir hil jaane tak rozi se mayous na hona dekho insan jab paida hota hai ek surkh boti hota hai badan par ek chhalka bhi nahi hota phir Allah Ta'ala use sab kuch deta hai" (Musnad Ahmad). 

Ba'z asmani kitabon mein hai "Ae Ibn-e-Adam main ne tujhe apni ibadat ke liye paida kiya hai isliye to isse ghaflat na kar tere rizq ka main zamin hoon to isme be-ja takleef na kar mujhe dhoond taake mujhe paaley jab to ne mujhe pa liya toh yaqeen maan ke to ne sab kuch pa liya aur agar main tujhe na mila toh samajh le ke tamam bhulaiyan to kho chuka sun tamam cheezon se ziyada mohabbat tere dil mein meri honi chahiye." 

Phir farmata hai yeh kafir mere azab ko jaldi kyun mang rahe hain? Woh azab toh unhe apne waqt par pahunch kar hi rahenge jaise unse pehle ke kafiron ko poche, Qiyamat ke din jis din ka unse wada hai unhe badi kharabi hogi. 

Alhamdulillah Surah Zariyat ki tafsir khatam hui.

Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein se un cheezon ki qasam kha kar jo uski azeem-us-shaan qudrat ki nishaniyan hain farmata hai ke uska azab ho kar hi rahega jab woh aayega kisi ki majal na hogi ke use hata sake. Toor us pahaad ko kehte hain jis par darakht hon jaise woh pahaad jis par Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se kalam kiya aur jahan se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko bheja tha aur jo khushk pahaad ho use jabal kaha jata hai toor nahi kaha jata. Aayat (Kitab Mastoor) se murad ya to Loh-e-Mahfooz hai ya Allah ki utari hui likhi hui kitabein hain jo insano par padhi jati hain isliye sath hi farma diya khule hue auraq mein. Aayat (Bait-ul-Ma'moor) ki babat Meraj wali hadis mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain satween aasman ke aage badhne ke baad mujhe Bait-ul-Ma'moor dikhwaya gaya jis mein har roz sattar hazaar farishte ibadat Allah ke liye jate hain, doosre din utne hi aur lekin jo aaj gaye unki bari phir qayamat tak nahi aati. Jis tarah zameen par Ka'batullah ka tawaf hota hai usi tarah aasmaniyon ke tawaf ki aur ibadat ki jagah woh hai. Isi hadis mein hai ke aap ne us waqt Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko dekha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor se kamar lagaye baithe hain is mein ek bareek nukta yeh hai ke chunke Khalilullah bani Baitullah the jinke haathoon zameen mein Ka'batullah bana tha to unhe wahan bhi uske kaabe se lage hue aap ne dekha. To goya is amal ki jaza usi jaisi Parvardigar ne apne Khalil ko di, yeh Bait-ul-Ma'moor theek Khana Ka'ba ke upar hai aur hai satween aasman par, yoon to har aasman mein ek aisa ghar hai jahan us aasman ke farishte Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karte hain pehle aasman jo isi jagah hai uska naam Bait-ul-Izzat hai Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hadis hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aasman mein ek ghar hai jise Ma'moor kehte hain jo Ka'ba ki samt mein hai, chauthe aasman mein ek nehar hai jiska naam Nehar-e-Haiwan hai Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) har roz is mein ghota lagate hain aur nikal kar badan jhadte hain jis se sattar hazaar qatray jhadte hain ek ek qatray se Allah Ta'ala ek ek farishta paida karta hai jinhe hukum hota hai ke woh Bait-ul-Ma'moor mein jayen aur namaz ada karein, phir woh wahan se nikal aate hain ab unhe dobara jane ki nobat nahi aati, unka ek sardar hota hai jise hukum diya jata hai ke unhe lekar kisi jagah khada hojaye phir woh Allah ki tasbeeh ke bayan mein lag jate hain, qayamat tak unka yehi shughal rehta hai, yeh hadis bahut hi ghareeb hai iske rawi Rooh bin Sabah is mein munfarid hain, hafizon ki ek jamalat ne un par ek hadis ka inkar kiya hai jaise Abu Zur'ah, Razi, Uqaili, Hakim waghaira Imam Hakim Abu Abdullah Nishapuri ise bilkul be-asl batate hain, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ek shakhs ne poochha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya woh aasman mein hai usey Suraah kaha jata hai, Ka'aba ke theek oopar hai jis tarah zameen ka Ka'aba hurmat ki jagah hai isi tarah woh aasmanon mein hurmat ki jagah hai, har roz is mein sattar hazaar farishtay namaz ada karte hain lekin jo aaj gaye hain un ki baari Qayamat tak dobara nahin aati kyunke farishton ki tadaad hi is qadar hai, ek riwayat mein hai yeh poochne wale Ibn-e-Kua thay, Ibn-e-Abbas se manqool hai ke yeh Arsh ke muhaaz mein hai, ek marfoo riwayat mein hai ke Sahaba ko ek din Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Bait-ul-Ma'moor ko jaante ho? Unhon ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool jaante hain, farmaya woh aasmani Ka'aba hai aur zameeni Ka'aba ke bilkul oopar hai aisa ke agar woh girey to isi par girey, is mein har roz sattar hazaar farishtay namaz ada karte hain jin ki baari Qayamat tak phir nahin aati, Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain yeh farishtay Iblees ke qabeelay ke jinnaat mein se hain, Wallahu A'alam. Oonchi chhat se muraad aasman hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Ja'alnas Sama'a Saqfan Mahfooza, Wa Hum An Aayatiha Mu'ridun) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 32). Rabee bin Anas farmate hain muraad is se Arsh hai is liye ke woh tamam makhlooq ki chhat hai, is qaul ki taujeeh is tarah ho sakti hai ke muraad aam ho. Aayat (Bahr-e-Masjoor) se muraad woh paani hai jo Arsh talay hai jo baarish ki tarah barsey ga jis se Qayamat ke din murday apni apni qabron se uthein ge, jamhoor kehte hain yahi darya muraad hain, unhein jo (Masjoor) kaha gaya hai yeh is liye ke Qayamat ke din un mein aag laga di jaye gi jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Izal Biharu Sujjirat) (Surah (At-Takweer: 6) jabke darya bharka diye jayenge aur un mein aag lag jaye gi jo phail kar tamam ahl-e-mahshar ko gher le gi. Hazrat Ala bin Badr kehte hain ke bhadakte hue darya is liye kaha gaya ke na is ka paani peene ke kaam mein aaye aur na kheti ko diya jaye, yahi haal Qayamat ke din daryaon ka hoga. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke darya behta hua aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke darya pur-shuda idhar udhar jaari. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain Masjoor se muraad faarigh yani khaali hai, koi laundi paani lene ko jaye phir laut kar kahe ke hauz masjoor hai is se muraad yahi hai ke khaali hai, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ma'ani yeh hain ke usey zameen se rok diya gaya hai is liye ke dubo na sake. Musnad-e-Ahmed ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke har raat teen martaba darya Allah Ta'ala se ijazat talab karta hai ke agar hukum ho to tamam logon ko dubo doon lekin Allah Ta'ala usey rok deta hai. Doosri riwayat mein hai ke ek buzurg Mujahid jo samundar ki sarhad ke lashkaron mein thay woh jihad ki tayari mein wahin rehte thay farmate hain ek raat mein chaukidari ke liye nikla us raat koi aur pehray par na tha, mein gasht karta hua maidan mein pahuncha aur wahan se samundar par nazrein dalein to aisa maloom hua ke goya samundar pahar ki chotiyon se takra raha hai, baar baar yahi nazara mein ne dekha.

Main ne Abu Salih se yeh waqiya bayan kiya, unhon ne ba-riwayat Hazrat Umar bin Khattab upar wali hadis mujhe sunayi lekin iski sanad mein aik raawi mubham hai jis ka naam nahin liya gaya. In qasmon ke baad ab jis cheez par qasmein khayi gayi thin un ka bayan ho raha hai ke kafiron ko jo azab-e-Ilahiya hone wala hai woh yaqeeni taur par aane wala hi hai, jab woh aayega kisi ke bas mein is ka rokna na hoga.

Ibn Abi Dunya mein hai ke aik raat Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) shahar ki dekh bhal ke liye nikle to aik makaan se kisi Musalman ki Quran-khwani ki aawaz kaan mein padi, woh Surah At-Tur padh rahe the. Aap ne sawari rok li aur khade ho kar Quran sunne lage, jab woh is ayat par poonche to zuban se nikal gaya ke Rab-e-Kaaba ki qasoom sachi hai. Phir apne gadhe se utar pade aur deewar se takiya laga kar baith gaye, chalne phirne ki taqat na rahi. Der tak baithne ke baad jab hosh-o-hawas thikane aaye woh apne ghar poonche lekin Allah ke kalam ki is darauni ayat ke asar se dil ki kamzori ki yeh halat thi ke mahina bhar tak bimar pade rahe aur aise ke log bimar-porsi ko aate the go kisi ko maloom na tha ke beemari kya hai (R.A).

Allah ka azab, farishton ki maar, jahannam ki aag un ke liye hogi jo duniya mein mashghool the aur deen ko aik khel tamasha muqarrar kar rakha tha. Aayat (Kitab Mastoor) se murad ya to Loh-e-Mahfooz hai ya Allah ki utari hui likhi hui kitabein hain jo insano par padhi jati hain isliye sath hi farma diya khule hue auraq mein. Aayat (Bait-ul-Ma'moor) ki babat Meraj wali hadis mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain satween aasman ke aage badhne ke baad mujhe Bait-ul-Ma'moor dikhwaya gaya jis mein har roz sattar hazaar farishte ibadat Allah ke liye jate hain, doosre din utne hi aur lekin jo aaj gaye unki bari phir qayamat tak nahi aati. Jis tarah zameen par Ka'batullah ka tawaf hota hai usi tarah aasmaniyon ke tawaf ki aur ibadat ki jagah woh hai. To goya is amal ki jaza usi jaisi Parvardigar ne apne Khalil ko di, yeh Bait-ul-Ma'moor theek Khana Ka'ba ke upar hai aur hai satween aasman par, yoon to har aasman mein ek aisa ghar hai jahan us aasman ke farishte Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karte hain pehle aasman jo isi jagah hai uska naam Bait-ul-Izzat hai Wallahu A'lam. Oonchi chhat se muraad aasman hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Ja'alnas Sama'a Saqfan Mahfooza, Wa Hum An Aayatiha Mu'ridun) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 32). Rabee bin Anas farmate hain muraad is se Arsh hai is liye ke woh tamam makhlooq ki chhat hai, is qaul ki taujeeh is tarah ho sakti hai ke muraad aam ho. Aayat (Bahr-e-Masjoor) se muraad woh paani hai jo Arsh talay hai jo baarish ki tarah barsey ga jis se Qayamat ke din murday apni apni qabron se uthein ge, jamhoor kehte hain yahi darya muraad hain, unhein jo (Masjoor) kaha gaya hai yeh is liye ke Qayamat ke din un mein aag laga di jaye gi jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Izal Biharu Sujjirat) (Surah (At-Takweer: 6) jabke darya bharka diye jayenge aur un mein aag lag jaye gi jo phail kar tamam ahl-e-mahshar ko gher le gi. Doosri riwayat mein hai ke ek buzurg Mujahid jo samundar ki sarhad ke lashkaron mein thay woh jihad ki tayari mein wahin rehte thay farmate hain ek raat mein chaukidari ke liye nikla us raat koi aur pehray par na tha, mein gasht karta hua maidan mein pahuncha aur wahan se samundar par nazrein dalein to aisa maloom hua ke goya samundar pahar ki chotiyon se takra raha hai, baar baar yahi nazara mein ne dekha.

Unhon ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool jaante hain, farmaya woh aasmani Ka'aba hai aur zameeni Ka'aba ke bilkul oopar hai aisa ke agar woh girey to isi par girey, is mein har roz sattar hazaar farishtay namaz ada karte hain jin ki baari Qayamat tak phir nahin aati, Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain yeh farishtay Iblees ke qabeelay ke jinnaat mein se hain, Wallahu A'alam. Oonchi chhat se muraad aasman hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Ja'alnas Sama'a Saqfan Mahfooza, Wa Hum An Aayatiha Mu'ridun) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 32). Rabee bin Anas farmate hain muraad is se Arsh hai is liye ke woh tamam makhlooq ki chhat hai, is qaul ki taujeeh is tarah ho sakti hai ke muraad aam ho. Aayat (Bahr-e-Masjoor) se muraad woh paani hai jo Arsh talay hai jo baarish ki tarah barsey ga jis se Qayamat ke din murday apni apni qabron se uthein ge, jamhoor kehte hain yahi darya muraad hain, unhein jo (Masjoor) kaha gaya hai yeh is liye ke Qayamat ke din un mein aag laga di jaye gi jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Izal Biharu Sujjirat) (Surah (At-Takweer: 6) jabke darya bharka diye jayenge aur un mein aag lag jaye gi jo phail kar tamam ahl-e-mahshar ko gher le gi. Hazrat Ala bin Badr kehte hain ke bhadakte hue darya is liye kaha gaya ke na is ka paani peene ke kaam mein aaye aur na kheti ko diya jaye, yahi haal Qayamat ke din daryaon ka hoga. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke darya behta hua aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke darya pur-shuda idhar udhar jaari. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain Masjoor se muraad faarigh yani khaali hai, koi laundi paani lene ko jaye phir laut kar kahe ke hauz masjoor hai is se muraad yahi hai ke khaali hai, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ma'ani yeh hain ke usey zameen se rok diya gaya hai is liye ke dubo na sake. Musnad-e-Ahmed ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke har raat teen martaba darya Allah Ta'ala se ijazat talab karta hai ke agar hukum ho to tamam logon ko dubo doon lekin Allah Ta'ala usey rok deta hai. Doosri riwayat mein hai ke ek buzurg Mujahid jo samundar ki sarhad ke lashkaron mein thay woh jihad ki tayari mein wahin rehte thay farmate hain ek raat mein chaukidari ke liye nikla us raat koi aur pehray par na tha, mein gasht karta hua maidan mein pahuncha aur wahan se samundar par nazrein dalein to aisa maloom hua ke goya samundar pahar ki chotiyon se takra raha hai, baar baar yahi nazara mein ne dekha.

Main ne Abu Salih se yeh waqiya bayan kiya, unhon ne ba-riwayat Hazrat Umar bin Khattab upar wali hadis mujhe sunayi lekin iski sanad mein aik raawi mubham hai jis ka naam nahin liya gaya. In qasmon ke baad ab jis cheez par qasmein khayi gayi thin un ka bayan ho raha hai ke kafiron ko jo azab-e-Ilahiya hone wala hai woh yaqeeni taur par aane wala hi hai, jab woh aayega kisi ke bas mein is ka rokna na hoga.

Ibn Abi Dunya mein hai ke aik raat Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) shahar ki dekh bhal ke liye nikle to aik makaan se kisi Musalman ki Quran-khwani ki aawaz kaan mein padi, woh Surah At-Tur padh rahe the. Aap ne sawari rok li aur khade ho kar Quran sunne lage, jab woh is ayat par poonche to zuban se nikal gaya ke Rab-e-Kaaba ki qasoom sachi hai. Phir apne gadhe se utar pade aur deewar se takiya laga kar baith gaye, chalne phirne ki taqat na rahi. Der tak baithne ke baad jab hosh-o-hawas thikane aaye woh apne ghar poonche lekin Allah ke kalam ki is darauni ayat ke asar se dil ki kamzori ki yeh halat thi ke mahina bhar tak bimar pade rahe aur aise ke log bimar-porsi ko aate the go kisi ko maloom na tha ke beemari kya hai (R.A).

Aap ne sawari rok li aur khade ho kar Quran sunne lage, jab woh is ayat par poonche to zuban se nikal gaya ke Rab-e-Kaaba ki qasoom sachi hai. Phir apne gadhe se utar pade aur deewar se takiya laga kar baith gaye, chalne phirne ki taqat na rahi. "Us din aasman thar-tharaye ga, phat jayega, chakkar khane lagega, pahaad apni jagah se hil jayenge, hat jayenge, idhar ke idhar ho jayenge, kaanp-kaanp kar tukde-tukde ho kar phir reza-reza ho jayenge, aakhir rui ke galon ki tarah idhar-udhar udhar jayenge aur be-naam-o-nishaan ho jayenge. Allah ka azab, farishton ki maar, jahannam ki aag un ke liye hogi jo duniya mein mashghool the aur deen ko aik khel tamasha muqarrar kar rakha tha. Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein se un cheezon ki qasam kha kar jo uski azeem-us-shaan qudrat ki nishaniyan hain farmata hai ke uska azab ho kar hi rahega jab woh aayega kisi ki majal na hogi ke use hata sake. Toor us pahaad ko kehte hain jis par darakht hon jaise woh pahaad jis par Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se kalam kiya aur jahan se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko bheja tha aur jo khushk pahaad ho use jabal kaha jata hai toor nahi kaha jata. Aayat (Kitab Mastoor) se murad ya to Loh-e-Mahfooz hai ya Allah ki utari hui likhi hui kitabein hain jo insano par padhi jati hain isliye sath hi farma diya khule hue auraq mein. Aayat (Bait-ul-Ma'moor) ki babat Meraj wali hadis mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain satween aasman ke aage badhne ke baad mujhe Bait-ul-Ma'moor dikhwaya gaya jis mein har roz sattar hazaar farishte ibadat Allah ke liye jate hain, doosre din utne hi aur lekin jo aaj gaye unki bari phir qayamat tak nahi aati. Jis tarah zameen par Ka'batullah ka tawaf hota hai usi tarah aasmaniyon ke tawaf ki aur ibadat ki jagah woh hai. Isi hadis mein hai ke aap ne us waqt Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko dekha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor se kamar lagaye baithe hain is mein ek bareek nukta yeh hai ke chunke Khalilullah bani Baitullah the jinke haathoon zameen mein Ka'batullah bana tha to unhe wahan bhi uske kaabe se lage hue aap ne dekha. To goya is amal ki jaza usi jaisi Parvardigar ne apne Khalil ko di, yeh Bait-ul-Ma'moor theek Khana Ka'ba ke upar hai aur hai satween aasman par, yoon to har aasman mein ek aisa ghar hai jahan us aasman ke farishte Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karte hain pehle aasman jo isi jagah hai uska naam Bait-ul-Izzat hai Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hadis hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aasman mein ek ghar hai jise Ma'moor kehte hain jo Ka'ba ki samt mein hai, chauthe aasman mein ek nehar hai jiska naam Nehar-e-Haiwan hai Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) har roz is mein ghota lagate hain aur nikal kar badan jhadte hain jis se sattar hazaar qatray jhadte hain ek ek qatray se Allah Ta'ala ek ek farishta paida karta hai jinhe hukum hota hai ke woh Bait-ul-Ma'moor mein jayen aur namaz ada karein, phir woh wahan se nikal aate hain ab unhe dobara jane ki nobat nahi aati, unka ek sardar hota hai jise hukum diya jata hai ke unhe lekar kisi jagah khada hojaye phir woh Allah ki tasbeeh ke bayan mein lag jate hain, qayamat tak unka yehi shughal rehta hai, yeh hadis bahut hi ghareeb hai iske rawi Rooh bin Sabah is mein munfarid hain, hafizon ki ek jamalat ne un par ek hadis ka inkar kiya hai jaise Abu Zur'ah, Razi, Uqaili, Hakim waghaira Imam Hakim Abu Abdullah Nishapuri ise bilkul be-asl batate hain, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ek shakhs ne poochha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor kya hai?

Aayat (Bait-ul-Ma'moor) ki babat Meraj wali hadis mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain satween aasman ke aage badhne ke baad mujhe Bait-ul-Ma'moor dikhwaya gaya jis mein har roz sattar hazaar farishte ibadat Allah ke liye jate hain, doosre din utne hi aur lekin jo aaj gaye unki bari phir qayamat tak nahi aati. Jis tarah zameen par Ka'batullah ka tawaf hota hai usi tarah aasmaniyon ke tawaf ki aur ibadat ki jagah woh hai. Isi hadis mein hai ke aap ne us waqt Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko dekha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor se kamar lagaye baithe hain is mein ek bareek nukta yeh hai ke chunke Khalilullah bani Baitullah the jinke haathoon zameen mein Ka'batullah bana tha to unhe wahan bhi uske kaabe se lage hue aap ne dekha. To goya is amal ki jaza usi jaisi Parvardigar ne apne Khalil ko di, yeh Bait-ul-Ma'moor theek Khana Ka'ba ke upar hai aur hai satween aasman par, yoon to har aasman mein ek aisa ghar hai jahan us aasman ke farishte Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karte hain pehle aasman jo isi jagah hai uska naam Bait-ul-Izzat hai Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hadis hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aasman mein ek ghar hai jise Ma'moor kehte hain jo Ka'ba ki samt mein hai, chauthe aasman mein ek nehar hai jiska naam Nehar-e-Haiwan hai Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) har roz is mein ghota lagate hain aur nikal kar badan jhadte hain jis se sattar hazaar qatray jhadte hain ek ek qatray se Allah Ta'ala ek ek farishta paida karta hai jinhe hukum hota hai ke woh Bait-ul-Ma'moor mein jayen aur namaz ada karein, phir woh wahan se nikal aate hain ab unhe dobara jane ki nobat nahi aati, unka ek sardar hota hai jise hukum diya jata hai ke unhe lekar kisi jagah khada hojaye phir woh Allah ki tasbeeh ke bayan mein lag jate hain, qayamat tak unka yehi shughal rehta hai, yeh hadis bahut hi ghareeb hai iske rawi Rooh bin Sabah is mein munfarid hain, hafizon ki ek jamalat ne un par ek hadis ka inkar kiya hai jaise Abu Zur'ah, Razi, Uqaili, Hakim waghaira Imam Hakim Abu Abdullah Nishapuri ise bilkul be-asl batate hain, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ek shakhs ne poochha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya woh aasman mein hai usey Suraah kaha jata hai, Ka'aba ke theek oopar hai jis tarah zameen ka Ka'aba hurmat ki jagah hai isi tarah woh aasmanon mein hurmat ki jagah hai, har roz is mein sattar hazaar farishtay namaz ada karte hain lekin jo aaj gaye hain un ki baari Qayamat tak dobara nahin aati kyunke farishton ki tadaad hi is qadar hai, ek riwayat mein hai yeh poochne wale Ibn-e-Kua thay, Ibn-e-Abbas se manqool hai ke yeh Arsh ke muhaaz mein hai, ek marfoo riwayat mein hai ke Sahaba ko ek din Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Bait-ul-Ma'moor ko jaante ho? Unhon ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool jaante hain, farmaya woh aasmani Ka'aba hai aur zameeni Ka'aba ke bilkul oopar hai aisa ke agar woh girey to isi par girey, is mein har roz sattar hazaar farishtay namaz ada karte hain jin ki baari Qayamat tak phir nahin aati, Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain yeh farishtay Iblees ke qabeelay ke jinnaat mein se hain, Wallahu A'alam. Oonchi chhat se muraad aasman hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Ja'alnas Sama'a Saqfan Mahfooza, Wa Hum An Aayatiha Mu'ridun) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 32). Rabee bin Anas farmate hain muraad is se Arsh hai is liye ke woh tamam makhlooq ki chhat hai, is qaul ki taujeeh is tarah ho sakti hai ke muraad aam ho. Aayat (Bahr-e-Masjoor) se muraad woh paani hai jo Arsh talay hai jo baarish ki tarah barsey ga jis se Qayamat ke din murday apni apni qabron se uthein ge, jamhoor kehte hain yahi darya muraad hain, unhein jo (Masjoor) kaha gaya hai yeh is liye ke Qayamat ke din un mein aag laga di jaye gi jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Izal Biharu Sujjirat) (Surah (At-Takweer: 6) jabke darya bharka diye jayenge aur un mein aag lag jaye gi jo phail kar tamam ahl-e-mahshar ko gher le gi. Hazrat Ala bin Badr kehte hain ke bhadakte hue darya is liye kaha gaya ke na is ka paani peene ke kaam mein aaye aur na kheti ko diya jaye, yahi haal Qayamat ke din daryaon ka hoga. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke darya behta hua aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke darya pur-shuda idhar udhar jaari. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain Masjoor se muraad faarigh yani khaali hai, koi laundi paani lene ko jaye phir laut kar kahe ke hauz masjoor hai is se muraad yahi hai ke khaali hai, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ma'ani yeh hain ke usey zameen se rok diya gaya hai is liye ke dubo na sake. Musnad-e-Ahmed ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke har raat teen martaba darya Allah Ta'ala se ijazat talab karta hai ke agar hukum ho to tamam logon ko dubo doon lekin Allah Ta'ala usey rok deta hai. Doosri riwayat mein hai ke ek buzurg Mujahid jo samundar ki sarhad ke lashkaron mein thay woh jihad ki tayari mein wahin rehte thay farmate hain ek raat mein chaukidari ke liye nikla us raat koi aur pehray par na tha, mein gasht karta hua maidan mein pahuncha aur wahan se samundar par nazrein dalein to aisa maloom hua ke goya samundar pahar ki chotiyon se takra raha hai, baar baar yahi nazara mein ne dekha.

Main ne Abu Salih se yeh waqiya bayan kiya, unhon ne ba-riwayat Hazrat Umar bin Khattab upar wali hadis mujhe sunayi lekin iski sanad mein aik raawi mubham hai jis ka naam nahin liya gaya. In qasmon ke baad ab jis cheez par qasmein khayi gayi thin un ka bayan ho raha hai ke kafiron ko jo azab-e-Ilahiya hone wala hai woh yaqeeni taur par aane wala hi hai, jab woh aayega kisi ke bas mein is ka rokna na hoga.

Ibn Abi Dunya mein hai ke aik raat Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) shahar ki dekh bhal ke liye nikle to aik makaan se kisi Musalman ki Quran-khwani ki aawaz kaan mein padi, woh Surah At-Tur padh rahe the. Aap ne sawari rok li aur khade ho kar Quran sunne lage, jab woh is ayat par poonche to zuban se nikal gaya ke Rab-e-Kaaba ki qasoom sachi hai. Phir apne gadhe se utar pade aur deewar se takiya laga kar baith gaye, chalne phirne ki taqat na rahi. Der tak baithne ke baad jab hosh-o-hawas thikane aaye woh apne ghar poonche lekin Allah ke kalam ki is darauni ayat ke asar se dil ki kamzori ki yeh halat thi ke mahina bhar tak bimar pade rahe aur aise ke log bimar-porsi ko aate the go kisi ko maloom na tha ke beemari kya hai (R.A).

Aik riwayat mein hai aap ki tilawat mein aik martaba yeh ayat aayi, usi waqt hichki bandh gayi aur is qadr qalb par asar pada ke bimar ho gaye, chunacha bees din tak ayadat ki jati rahi.

Yeh Allah ka zulm nahi balki sirf tumhare aamal ka badla hai."))

Main ne Abu Salih se yeh waqiya bayan kiya, unhon ne ba-riwayat Hazrat Umar bin Khattab upar wali hadis mujhe sunayi lekin iski sanad mein aik raawi mubham hai jis ka naam nahin liya gaya. Yeh Allah ka zulm nahi balki sirf tumhare aamal ka badla hai."))

Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein se un cheezon ki qasam kha kar jo uski azeem-us-shaan qudrat ki nishaniyan hain farmata hai ke uska azab ho kar hi rahega jab woh aayega kisi ki majal na hogi ke use hata sake. Toor us pahaad ko kehte hain jis par darakht hon jaise woh pahaad jis par Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se kalam kiya aur jahan se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko bheja tha aur jo khushk pahaad ho use jabal kaha jata hai toor nahi kaha jata. Aayat (Kitab Mastoor) se murad ya to Loh-e-Mahfooz hai ya Allah ki utari hui likhi hui kitabein hain jo insano par padhi jati hain isliye sath hi farma diya khule hue auraq mein. Aayat (Bait-ul-Ma'moor) ki babat Meraj wali hadis mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain satween aasman ke aage badhne ke baad mujhe Bait-ul-Ma'moor dikhwaya gaya jis mein har roz sattar hazaar farishte ibadat Allah ke liye jate hain, doosre din utne hi aur lekin jo aaj gaye unki bari phir qayamat tak nahi aati. Jis tarah zameen par Ka'batullah ka tawaf hota hai usi tarah aasmaniyon ke tawaf ki aur ibadat ki jagah woh hai. Isi hadis mein hai ke aap ne us waqt Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko dekha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor se kamar lagaye baithe hain is mein ek bareek nukta yeh hai ke chunke Khalilullah bani Baitullah the jinke haathoon zameen mein Ka'batullah bana tha to unhe wahan bhi uske kaabe se lage hue aap ne dekha. To goya is amal ki jaza usi jaisi Parvardigar ne apne Khalil ko di, yeh Bait-ul-Ma'moor theek Khana Ka'ba ke upar hai aur hai satween aasman par, yoon to har aasman mein ek aisa ghar hai jahan us aasman ke farishte Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karte hain pehle aasman jo isi jagah hai uska naam Bait-ul-Izzat hai Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hadis hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aasman mein ek ghar hai jise Ma'moor kehte hain jo Ka'ba ki samt mein hai, chauthe aasman mein ek nehar hai jiska naam Nehar-e-Haiwan hai Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) har roz is mein ghota lagate hain aur nikal kar badan jhadte hain jis se sattar hazaar qatray jhadte hain ek ek qatray se Allah Ta'ala ek ek farishta paida karta hai jinhe hukum hota hai ke woh Bait-ul-Ma'moor mein jayen aur namaz ada karein, phir woh wahan se nikal aate hain ab unhe dobara jane ki nobat nahi aati, unka ek sardar hota hai jise hukum diya jata hai ke unhe lekar kisi jagah khada hojaye phir woh Allah ki tasbeeh ke bayan mein lag jate hain, qayamat tak unka yehi shughal rehta hai, yeh hadis bahut hi ghareeb hai iske rawi Rooh bin Sabah is mein munfarid hain, hafizon ki ek jamalat ne un par ek hadis ka inkar kiya hai jaise Abu Zur'ah, Razi, Uqaili, Hakim waghaira Imam Hakim Abu Abdullah Nishapuri ise bilkul be-asl batate hain, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ek shakhs ne poochha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor kya hai?

Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein se un cheezon ki qasam kha kar jo uski azeem-us-shaan qudrat ki nishaniyan hain farmata hai ke uska azab ho kar hi rahega jab woh aayega kisi ki majal na hogi ke use hata sake. Toor us pahaad ko kehte hain jis par darakht hon jaise woh pahaad jis par Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se kalam kiya aur jahan se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko bheja tha aur jo khushk pahaad ho use jabal kaha jata hai toor nahi kaha jata. Aayat (Kitab Mastoor) se murad ya to Loh-e-Mahfooz hai ya Allah ki utari hui likhi hui kitabein hain jo insano par padhi jati hain isliye sath hi farma diya khule hue auraq mein. Aayat (Bait-ul-Ma'moor) ki babat Meraj wali hadis mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain satween aasman ke aage badhne ke baad mujhe Bait-ul-Ma'moor dikhwaya gaya jis mein har roz sattar hazaar farishte ibadat Allah ke liye jate hain, doosre din utne hi aur lekin jo aaj gaye unki bari phir qayamat tak nahi aati. Jis tarah zameen par Ka'batullah ka tawaf hota hai usi tarah aasmaniyon ke tawaf ki aur ibadat ki jagah woh hai. Isi hadis mein hai ke aap ne us waqt Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko dekha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor se kamar lagaye baithe hain is mein ek bareek nukta yeh hai ke chunke Khalilullah bani Baitullah the jinke haathoon zameen mein Ka'batullah bana tha to unhe wahan bhi uske kaabe se lage hue aap ne dekha. To goya is amal ki jaza usi jaisi Parvardigar ne apne Khalil ko di, yeh Bait-ul-Ma'moor theek Khana Ka'ba ke upar hai aur hai satween aasman par, yoon to har aasman mein ek aisa ghar hai jahan us aasman ke farishte Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karte hain pehle aasman jo isi jagah hai uska naam Bait-ul-Izzat hai Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hadis hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aasman mein ek ghar hai jise Ma'moor kehte hain jo Ka'ba ki samt mein hai, chauthe aasman mein ek nehar hai jiska naam Nehar-e-Haiwan hai Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) har roz is mein ghota lagate hain aur nikal kar badan jhadte hain jis se sattar hazaar qatray jhadte hain ek ek qatray se Allah Ta'ala ek ek farishta paida karta hai jinhe hukum hota hai ke woh Bait-ul-Ma'moor mein jayen aur namaz ada karein, phir woh wahan se nikal aate hain ab unhe dobara jane ki nobat nahi aati, unka ek sardar hota hai jise hukum diya jata hai ke unhe lekar kisi jagah khada hojaye phir woh Allah ki tasbeeh ke bayan mein lag jate hain, qayamat tak unka yehi shughal rehta hai, yeh hadis bahut hi ghareeb hai iske rawi Rooh bin Sabah is mein munfarid hain, hafizon ki ek jamalat ne un par ek hadis ka inkar kiya hai jaise Abu Zur'ah, Razi, Uqaili, Hakim waghaira Imam Hakim Abu Abdullah Nishapuri ise bilkul be-asl batate hain, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ek shakhs ne poochha ke Bait-ul-Ma'moor kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya woh aasman mein hai usey Suraah kaha jata hai, Ka'aba ke theek oopar hai jis tarah zameen ka Ka'aba hurmat ki jagah hai isi tarah woh aasmanon mein hurmat ki jagah hai, har roz is mein sattar hazaar farishtay namaz ada karte hain lekin jo aaj gaye hain un ki baari Qayamat tak dobara nahin aati kyunke farishton ki tadaad hi is qadar hai, ek riwayat mein hai yeh poochne wale Ibn-e-Kua thay, Ibn-e-Abbas se manqool hai ke yeh Arsh ke muhaaz mein hai, ek marfoo riwayat mein hai ke Sahaba ko ek din Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Bait-ul-Ma'moor ko jaante ho? Unhon ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool jaante hain, farmaya woh aasmani Ka'aba hai aur zameeni Ka'aba ke bilkul oopar hai aisa ke agar woh girey to isi par girey, is mein har roz sattar hazaar farishtay namaz ada karte hain jin ki baari Qayamat tak phir nahin aati, Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain yeh farishtay Iblees ke qabeelay ke jinnaat mein se hain, Wallahu A'alam. Oonchi chhat se muraad aasman hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Ja'alnas Sama'a Saqfan Mahfooza, Wa Hum An Aayatiha Mu'ridun) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 32). Rabee bin Anas farmate hain muraad is se Arsh hai is liye ke woh tamam makhlooq ki chhat hai, is qaul ki taujeeh is tarah ho sakti hai ke muraad aam ho. Aayat (Bahr-e-Masjoor) se muraad woh paani hai jo Arsh talay hai jo baarish ki tarah barsey ga jis se Qayamat ke din murday apni apni qabron se uthein ge, jamhoor kehte hain yahi darya muraad hain, unhein jo (Masjoor) kaha gaya hai yeh is liye ke Qayamat ke din un mein aag laga di jaye gi jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa Izal Biharu Sujjirat) (Surah (At-Takweer: 6) jabke darya bharka diye jayenge aur un mein aag lag jaye gi jo phail kar tamam ahl-e-mahshar ko gher le gi. Hazrat Ala bin Badr kehte hain ke bhadakte hue darya is liye kaha gaya ke na is ka paani peene ke kaam mein aaye aur na kheti ko diya jaye, yahi haal Qayamat ke din daryaon ka hoga. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke darya behta hua aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke darya pur-shuda idhar udhar jaari. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain Masjoor se muraad faarigh yani khaali hai, koi laundi paani lene ko jaye phir laut kar kahe ke hauz masjoor hai is se muraad yahi hai ke khaali hai, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ma'ani yeh hain ke usey zameen se rok diya gaya hai is liye ke dubo na sake. Musnad-e-Ahmed ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke har raat teen martaba darya Allah Ta'ala se ijazat talab karta hai ke agar hukum ho to tamam logon ko dubo doon lekin Allah Ta'ala usey rok deta hai. Doosri riwayat mein hai ke ek buzurg Mujahid jo samundar ki sarhad ke lashkaron mein thay woh jihad ki tayari mein wahin rehte thay farmate hain ek raat mein chaukidari ke liye nikla us raat koi aur pehray par na tha, mein gasht karta hua maidan mein pahuncha aur wahan se samundar par nazrein dalein to aisa maloom hua ke goya samundar pahar ki chotiyon se takra raha hai, baar baar yahi nazara mein ne dekha.

Main ne Abu Salih se yeh waqiya bayan kiya, unhon ne ba-riwayat Hazrat Umar bin Khattab upar wali hadis mujhe sunayi lekin iski sanad mein aik raawi mubham hai jis ka naam nahin liya gaya. In qasmon ke baad ab jis cheez par qasmein khayi gayi thin un ka bayan ho raha hai ke kafiron ko jo azab-e-Ilahiya hone wala hai woh yaqeeni taur par aane wala hi hai, jab woh aayega kisi ke bas mein is ka rokna na hoga.

Ibn Abi Dunya mein hai ke aik raat Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) shahar ki dekh bhal ke liye nikle to aik makaan se kisi Musalman ki Quran-khwani ki aawaz kaan mein padi, woh Surah At-Tur padh rahe the. Aap ne sawari rok li aur khade ho kar Quran sunne lage, jab woh is ayat par poonche to zuban se nikal gaya ke Rab-e-Kaaba ki qasoom sachi hai. Phir apne gadhe se utar pade aur deewar se takiya laga kar baith gaye, chalne phirne ki taqat na rahi. Der tak baithne ke baad jab hosh-o-hawas thikane aaye woh apne ghar poonche lekin Allah ke kalam ki is darauni ayat ke asar se dil ki kamzori ki yeh halat thi ke mahina bhar tak bimar pade rahe aur aise ke log bimar-porsi ko aate the go kisi ko maloom na tha ke beemari kya hai (R.A).

Manzar-e-Jannat

Allah Ta'ala naik bakhton ka anjam bayaan farha raha hai ke azaab-o-saza jo un badbakhton ko ho raha hai yeh is se mehfooz kar ke janton mein pohncha diye gaye jahan ki behtareen nematon se faida utha rahe hain aur har tarah khush haal khush dil hain. Qism qism ke khane, tarah tarah ke peene, behtareen libas, umda umda sawariyan, buland o bala makanat aur har tarah ki nematein unhein muhayya hain, kisi qism ka dar-o-khauf nahi. Allah farma chuka hai ke tumhein mere azabon se nijat mil gayi.

Gharz dukh se door, sukh se masroor, rahat-o-lazzat mein mamoor hain. Jo cheez samne aati hai woh aisi hai jise na kisi ankh ne dekha ho, na kisi kaan ne suna ho, na kisi dil par khayal tak guzra ho. Phir Allah ki taraf se baar baar mehman nawazi ke taur par un se kaha jata hai ke khate peete raho, khush-gawar khush-zaika betakalluf mazeed marghoub cheezein tumhare liye muhayya hain. Phir un ka dil khush karne, hausla barhane aur tabiyat mein amang paida karne ke liye sath hi elan hota hai ke yeh to tumhare aamal ka badla hai jo tum is jahan mein kar aaye ho.

Mursa-o-jarrao shahana takht par bari befikri aur farigh-ul-bali se takiye lagaye baithe honge. Sattar sattar saal guzar jayenge unhein zaroorat na hogi ke uthein ya hilen jilen. Beshumar saleeqa shaar adab dan khuddam har tarah ki khidmat ke liye kamar basta, jis cheez ko ji chahe aan ki aan mein maujood. Ankhon ka noor, dil ka suroor, waafir-o-mofoor samne be-inteha khubsurat khub-seerat gore gore pande wali bari bari raseeli ankhon wali bohat si hureen, paak dil, iffat-ma'ab, ismat, khush dil behlane aur khwahish poori karne ke liye samne khari, har ek nemat-o-rahmat charon taraf bikhri hui, phir bhala unhein kis cheez ki kami!

Sattar saal ke baad jab doosri taraf mail hote hain toh dekhte hain ke wahan aur hi manzar hai, har cheez nayi hai, har nemat joban par hai. Is taraf ki huoron par nazrein dalte hain toh un ke noor ki chaka-chound hairat mein daal deti hai. Un ki pyari pyari bhooli bhali shaklein, achhote pande aur kunwar-paney ki sharmili nazrein aur jawani ka bankpan dil par muqnatisi asar dalta hai. Jannati kuch kahe is se pehle hi woh apni shireen-kalami se ajeeb andaz se kehti hain: Shukr hai ke aapka eltefat hamari taraf bhi huwa. Gharz isi tarah mun-maani nematon se mast ho rahe hain.

Phir in jannatiyon ke takht bawajood qatar-waar hone ke is tarah na honge ke kisi ko kisi ki peeth ho balke samne samne honge, jaise aur jagah hai ayat: 
Wa naza'na ma fi sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan 'ala sururin mutaqabilin (Al-Hijr: 47) 
Takhton par honge aur ek doosre ke samne honge. 

Phir farmata hai hum ne unke nikah mein hureen de rakhi hain jo kabhi dil mela na karein, jab ankh pare ji khush ho jaye aur zahiri khubsurati ki toh kisi se tareef hi kya ho sakti hai? Unke ausaf ke bayan ki hadeesein waghera kayi maqamat par guzar chuki hain isliye unhein yahan warid karna kuch chandana zaroori nahi.

Phir farmata hai hum ne unke nikah mein hureen de rakhi hain jo kabhi dil mela na karein, jab ankh pare ji khush ho jaye aur zahiri khubsurati ki toh kisi se tareef hi kya ho sakti hai? Unke ausaf ke bayan ki hadeesein waghera kayi maqamat par guzar chuki hain isliye unhein yahan warid karna kuch chandana zaroori nahi.

Salih aulad anmol asasa. Allah Ta'ala Jal Shanahu apnay fazl-o-karam aur lutf-o-rahm apnay ehsan aur inam ka bayan farmata hai ke jin momino ki aulad bhi iman mein apnay baap dada ki rah mein lag jaye lekin aamal-e-salihah mein apnay baro se kam ho parwardigar un ke naik aamal ka badla barha charha kar unhe un ke baro ke darjay mein pohncha de ga taake baro ki ankhain choto ko apnay pas dekh kar thandi rahain aur chote bhi apnay baro ke pas hashash bashash rahain. Un ke amalo ki barhotari un ke buzurgo ke aamal ki kami se na ki jaye ga balki muhsin-o-meharban Allah unhe apnay mamoor khazano mein se ata farmaye ga. Hazrat Ibn Abbas is ayat ki tafsir yehi farmate hain. Aik marfoo hadith bhi is mazmoon ki marwi hai, aik aur riwayat mein hai ke jab jannati shakhs jannat mein jaye ga aur apnay ma baap aur biwi bacho ko na payega to daryaft kare ga ke woh kahan hain? Jawab milega ke woh tumhare martaba tak nahi pohnchay. Ye kahega Bari Ta'ala maine to apnay liye aur unke liye naik aamal kiye thay, chunancha hukum diya jayega aur unhe bhi un ke darjay mein pohncha diya jayega. Ye bhi marwi hai ke jannatiyo ke bacho ne iman qabool kiya aur naik kaam kiye woh to un ke sath mila diye jayenge lekin un ke jo chote bache chhot pan hi mein intiqal kar gaye thay woh bhi un ke pas pohncha diye jayenge. Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Sha'bi, Saeed bin Jubair, Ibrahim, Qatada, Abu Salih, Rabi bin Anas, Dahhak bin Zaid bhi yehi kehte hain. Imam Ibn Jarir bhi isisi ko pasand farmate hain.
Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Khadija ne Nabi ﷺ se apnay do bacho ki nisbat daryaft kiya jo zamana-e-jahiliyat mein maray thay to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya woh dono jahannam mein hain. Phir jab Mai Sahiba ko ghamgeen dekha to farmaya agar tum un ki jagah dekh litin to tumhare dil mein un ka bughz paida hojata. Mai Sahiba ne poocha Ya RasulAllah ﷺ mera bacha jo ap se hua woh kahan hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya woh jannat mein hai, momin ma' apni aulad ke jannat mein hain. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne is ayat ki tilawat ki.
Ye to hui ma baap ke aamal-e-salihah ki wajah se aulad ki buzurgi, ab aulad ki dua-e-khair ki wajah se ma baap ki buzurgi mulahiza ho. Musnad Ahmad mein hadith hai ke RasulAllah ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala apnay naik bande ka darja jannat mein daf'atan barhata hai, woh daryaft karta hai ke Allah mera ye darja kaise barh gaya? Allah Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke teri aulad ne tere liye istighfar kiya is bina par maine tera darja barha diya. Is hadith ki isnad bilkul sahi hain, go Bukhari Muslim mein in lafzo se nahi ayi lekin is jaisi aik riwayat Sahih Muslim mein isi tarah marwi hai ke Ibn Adam ke marte hi us ke aamal moqoof hojate hain lekin teen amal ke woh marne ke bad bhi sawab pohnchatay rehte hain.

Sadaqa-e-Jariya, ilm-e-deen jis se nafa pohnchta hai, naik aulaad jo marne wale ke liye dua-e-khair karti rahe. Chونکہ yahan bayaan hua tha ke momino ki aulaad ke darje be-amal barha diye gaye the, toh sath hi sath apne is fazl ke baad apne adl ka bayaan farmata hai ke kisi ko kisi ke aamal mein pakra na jayega balki har shakhs apne apne amal mein rahin hoga, baap ka bojh bete par aur bete ka baap par na hoga. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Kullu nafsin bima kasabat rahinah - 74. (Al-Muddassir: 38), har shakhs apne kiye huye kaamo mein giraftar hai magar woh jin ke dayen hath mein nama-e-aamal pohnche, woh jannaton mein baithe huye gunahgaron se daryaft karte hain. 

Phir irshad hota hai ke in jannatiyon ko qism qism ke mewe aur tarah tarah ke gosht diye jaate hain, jis cheez ko jee chahe, jis par dil aaye woh yak-lakht maujud ho jaati hai. Sharab-e-Tohur ke chhalakte huye jaam ek dusre ko pila rahe hain, jis ke peene se suroor aur kaif, lutf aur bahaar hasil hoti hai, lekin bad-zubani behuda-goi nahi hoti, hizyan nahi bakte, behosh nahi hote. Sacha suroor aur poori khushi hasil, bak-jhak se dur, gunah se ghafil, baatil-o-kizb se dur, gheebat-o-gunah se nafoor. 

Duniya mein sharabiyon ki halat dekhi hogi ke un ke sar mein chakkar, pet mein dard, aql zail, bakwaas bahut, bu buri, chehre be-ronaq. Isi tarah sharab ke bad-zaiqa aur badbu. Yahan jannat ki sharab in tamam gandiyon se koso dur hai, yeh rang mein safed, peene mein khush-zaiqa, na is ke peene se hawas muattal ho, na bak-jhak ho, na bahein, na bhatke, na masti ho, na aur kisi tarah zarar pohnchaye. Hasi khushi is pak sharab ke jaam pila rahe honge. 

Un ke ghulam kamsan, nau-umar bachche jo husn-o-khobi mein aise hain jaise marwarid hon aur woh bhi dabbe mein band rakhe gaye hon, kisi ka hath bhi na laga ho aur abhi abhi taaze taaze nikale hon. Un ki aab-dari, safai, chamak-damak, roop-rang ka kya poochna? Lekin in ghulman ke haseen chehre unhe bhi maand kar dete hain. Aur jagah yeh mazmoon in alfaaz mein ada kiya gaya hai aayat: (Yatoofu 'alaihim wildanun mukhalladoon - 17).

(Al-Waqi'ah: 17) Ya'ni hamesha nau-umar aur kam-sin rehne wale bachche, aab-khore, aaftab-e aur aisi sharab-e saf ke jaam ke jin ke pine se na sar mein dard ho na behkein, aur jis qisam ka mewa yeh pasand karein aur jis parind ka gosht yeh chahein un ke paas baar baar laane ke liye charon taraf kamar-basta chal rahe hain. Is daur-e sharab ke waqt aapas mein ghul-mil kar tarah tarah ki baatein karein ge, duniya ke ahwal yaad aayein ge, kahenge ke hum duniya mein jab apne walon mein the to apne Rab ke aaj ke din ke azab se sakht larzan-o-tarsan the. Alhamdulillah, Rab ne hum par khas ehsaan kiya aur hamare khauf ki cheez se humein amn diya, hum usi se duayein aur iltijaein karte rahe us ne hamari duayein qabul farmaen aur hamara qaul poora kar diya, yaqinan woh bahut hi nek suluk aur raham wala hai. 

Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Jannati apne doston se milna chahega to udhar dost ke dil mein bhi yehi khwahish paida hogi, us ka takht udega aur raste mein dono mil jayenge, apne apne takhton par aaram se baithe hue baatein karne lagenge, duniya ke zikr ko chhedenge aur kahenge ke flan din flan jagah hum ne apni bakhshish ki dua mangi thi, Allah ne use qabul farmaya. Is hadis ki sanad kamzor hai. 

Hazrat Ma'isha [Aisha] R.A ne jab is aayat ki tilawat ki to yeh dua padhi: Allahumma min 'alayna wa qina 'azab as-samoom innaka antal-barrur-raheem. 
Hazrat A'mash rawi-e-hadis se poochha gaya ke is aayat ko padh kar yeh dua Umm-ul-Mu'mineen ne namaz mein mangi thi? Jawab diya: Haan.)

Un ke amalo ki barhotari un ke buzurgo ke aamal ki kami se na ki jaye ga balki muhsin-o-meharban Allah unhe apnay mamoor khazano mein se ata farmaye ga. Hazrat Ibn Abbas is ayat ki tafsir yehi farmate hain. Aik marfoo hadith bhi is mazmoon ki marwi hai, aik aur riwayat mein hai ke jab jannati shakhs jannat mein jaye ga aur apnay ma baap aur biwi bacho ko na payega to daryaft kare ga ke woh kahan hain? Jawab milega ke woh tumhare martaba tak nahi pohnchay. Ye kahega Bari Ta'ala maine to apnay liye aur unke liye naik aamal kiye thay, chunancha hukum diya jayega aur unhe bhi un ke darjay mein pohncha diya jayega. Ye bhi marwi hai ke jannatiyo ke bacho ne iman qabool kiya aur naik kaam kiye woh to un ke sath mila diye jayenge lekin un ke jo chote bache chhot pan hi mein intiqal kar gaye thay woh bhi un ke pas pohncha diye jayenge. Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Sha'bi, Saeed bin Jubair, Ibrahim, Qatada, Abu Salih, Rabi bin Anas, Dahhak bin Zaid bhi yehi kehte hain. Imam Ibn Jarir bhi isisi ko pasand farmate hain.
Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Khadija ne Nabi ﷺ se apnay do bacho ki nisbat daryaft kiya jo zamana-e-jahiliyat mein maray thay to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya woh dono jahannam mein hain. Phir jab Mai Sahiba ko ghamgeen dekha to farmaya agar tum un ki jagah dekh litin to tumhare dil mein un ka bughz paida hojata. Mai Sahiba ne poocha Ya RasulAllah ﷺ mera bacha jo ap se hua woh kahan hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya woh jannat mein hai, momin ma' apni aulad ke jannat mein hain. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne is ayat ki tilawat ki.
Ye to hui ma baap ke aamal-e-salihah ki wajah se aulad ki buzurgi, ab aulad ki dua-e-khair ki wajah se ma baap ki buzurgi mulahiza ho. Musnad Ahmad mein hadith hai ke RasulAllah ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala apnay naik bande ka darja jannat mein daf'atan barhata hai, woh daryaft karta hai ke Allah mera ye darja kaise barh gaya? Allah Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke teri aulad ne tere liye istighfar kiya is bina par maine tera darja barha diya. Is hadith ki isnad bilkul sahi hain, go Bukhari Muslim mein in lafzo se nahi ayi lekin is jaisi aik riwayat Sahih Muslim mein isi tarah marwi hai ke Ibn Adam ke marte hi us ke aamal moqoof hojate hain lekin teen amal ke woh marne ke bad bhi sawab pohnchatay rehte hain.

Sadaqa-e-Jariya, ilm-e-deen jis se nafa pohnchta hai, naik aulaad jo marne wale ke liye dua-e-khair karti rahe. Chونکہ yahan bayaan hua tha ke momino ki aulaad ke darje be-amal barha diye gaye the, toh sath hi sath apne is fazl ke baad apne adl ka bayaan farmata hai ke kisi ko kisi ke aamal mein pakra na jayega balki har shakhs apne apne amal mein rahin hoga, baap ka bojh bete par aur bete ka baap par na hoga. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Kullu nafsin bima kasabat rahinah - 74. (Al-Muddassir: 38), har shakhs apne kiye huye kaamo mein giraftar hai magar woh jin ke dayen hath mein nama-e-aamal pohnche, woh jannaton mein baithe huye gunahgaron se daryaft karte hain. 

Phir irshad hota hai ke in jannatiyon ko qism qism ke mewe aur tarah tarah ke gosht diye jaate hain, jis cheez ko jee chahe, jis par dil aaye woh yak-lakht maujud ho jaati hai. Sharab-e-Tohur ke chhalakte huye jaam ek dusre ko pila rahe hain, jis ke peene se suroor aur kaif, lutf aur bahaar hasil hoti hai, lekin bad-zubani behuda-goi nahi hoti, hizyan nahi bakte, behosh nahi hote. Sacha suroor aur poori khushi hasil, bak-jhak se dur, gunah se ghafil, baatil-o-kizb se dur, gheebat-o-gunah se nafoor. 

Duniya mein sharabiyon ki halat dekhi hogi ke un ke sar mein chakkar, pet mein dard, aql zail, bakwaas bahut, bu buri, chehre be-ronaq. Isi tarah sharab ke bad-zaiqa aur badbu. Yahan jannat ki sharab in tamam gandiyon se koso dur hai, yeh rang mein safed, peene mein khush-zaiqa, na is ke peene se hawas muattal ho, na bak-jhak ho, na bahein, na bhatke, na masti ho, na aur kisi tarah zarar pohnchaye. Hasi khushi is pak sharab ke jaam pila rahe honge. 

Un ke ghulam kamsan, nau-umar bachche jo husn-o-khobi mein aise hain jaise marwarid hon aur woh bhi dabbe mein band rakhe gaye hon, kisi ka hath bhi na laga ho aur abhi abhi taaze taaze nikale hon. Un ki aab-dari, safai, chamak-damak, roop-rang ka kya poochna? Lekin in ghulman ke haseen chehre unhe bhi maand kar dete hain. Aur jagah yeh mazmoon in alfaaz mein ada kiya gaya hai aayat: (Yatoofu 'alaihim wildanun mukhalladoon - 17).

(Al-Waqi'ah: 17) Ya'ni hamesha nau-umar aur kam-sin rehne wale bachche, aab-khore, aaftab-e aur aisi sharab-e saf ke jaam ke jin ke pine se na sar mein dard ho na behkein, aur jis qisam ka mewa yeh pasand karein aur jis parind ka gosht yeh chahein un ke paas baar baar laane ke liye charon taraf kamar-basta chal rahe hain. Is daur-e sharab ke waqt aapas mein ghul-mil kar tarah tarah ki baatein karein ge, duniya ke ahwal yaad aayein ge, kahenge ke hum duniya mein jab apne walon mein the to apne Rab ke aaj ke din ke azab se sakht larzan-o-tarsan the. Alhamdulillah, Rab ne hum par khas ehsaan kiya aur hamare khauf ki cheez se humein amn diya, hum usi se duayein aur iltijaein karte rahe us ne hamari duayein qabul farmaen aur hamara qaul poora kar diya, yaqinan woh bahut hi nek suluk aur raham wala hai. 

Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Jannati apne doston se milna chahega to udhar dost ke dil mein bhi yehi khwahish paida hogi, us ka takht udega aur raste mein dono mil jayenge, apne apne takhton par aaram se baithe hue baatein karne lagenge, duniya ke zikr ko chhedenge aur kahenge ke flan din flan jagah hum ne apni bakhshish ki dua mangi thi, Allah ne use qabul farmaya. Is hadis ki sanad kamzor hai. 

Hazrat Ma'isha [Aisha] R.A ne jab is aayat ki tilawat ki to yeh dua padhi: Allahumma min 'alayna wa qina 'azab as-samoom innaka antal-barrur-raheem. 
Hazrat A'mash rawi-e-hadis se poochha gaya ke is aayat ko padh kar yeh dua Umm-ul-Mu'mineen ne namaz mein mangi thi? Jawab diya: Haan.)

Ye kahega Bari Ta'ala maine to apnay liye aur unke liye naik aamal kiye thay, chunancha hukum diya jayega aur unhe bhi un ke darjay mein pohncha diya jayega. Ye bhi marwi hai ke jannatiyo ke bacho ne iman qabool kiya aur naik kaam kiye woh to un ke sath mila diye jayenge lekin un ke jo chote bache chhot pan hi mein intiqal kar gaye thay woh bhi un ke pas pohncha diye jayenge. Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Sha'bi, Saeed bin Jubair, Ibrahim, Qatada, Abu Salih, Rabi bin Anas, Dahhak bin Zaid bhi yehi kehte hain. Imam Ibn Jarir bhi isisi ko pasand farmate hain.
Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Khadija ne Nabi ﷺ se apnay do bacho ki nisbat daryaft kiya jo zamana-e-jahiliyat mein maray thay to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya woh dono jahannam mein hain. Phir jab Mai Sahiba ko ghamgeen dekha to farmaya agar tum un ki jagah dekh litin to tumhare dil mein un ka bughz paida hojata. Mai Sahiba ne poocha Ya RasulAllah ﷺ mera bacha jo ap se hua woh kahan hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya woh jannat mein hai, momin ma' apni aulad ke jannat mein hain. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne is ayat ki tilawat ki.
Ye to hui ma baap ke aamal-e-salihah ki wajah se aulad ki buzurgi, ab aulad ki dua-e-khair ki wajah se ma baap ki buzurgi mulahiza ho. Musnad Ahmad mein hadith hai ke RasulAllah ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala apnay naik bande ka darja jannat mein daf'atan barhata hai, woh daryaft karta hai ke Allah mera ye darja kaise barh gaya? Allah Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke teri aulad ne tere liye istighfar kiya is bina par maine tera darja barha diya. Is hadith ki isnad bilkul sahi hain, go Bukhari Muslim mein in lafzo se nahi ayi lekin is jaisi aik riwayat Sahih Muslim mein isi tarah marwi hai ke Ibn Adam ke marte hi us ke aamal moqoof hojate hain lekin teen amal ke woh marne ke bad bhi sawab pohnchatay rehte hain.

Sadaqa-e-Jariya, ilm-e-deen jis se nafa pohnchta hai, naik aulaad jo marne wale ke liye dua-e-khair karti rahe. Chونکہ yahan bayaan hua tha ke momino ki aulaad ke darje be-amal barha diye gaye the, toh sath hi sath apne is fazl ke baad apne adl ka bayaan farmata hai ke kisi ko kisi ke aamal mein pakra na jayega balki har shakhs apne apne amal mein rahin hoga, baap ka bojh bete par aur bete ka baap par na hoga. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Kullu nafsin bima kasabat rahinah - 74. (Al-Muddassir: 38), har shakhs apne kiye huye kaamo mein giraftar hai magar woh jin ke dayen hath mein nama-e-aamal pohnche, woh jannaton mein baithe huye gunahgaron se daryaft karte hain. 

Phir irshad hota hai ke in jannatiyon ko qism qism ke mewe aur tarah tarah ke gosht diye jaate hain, jis cheez ko jee chahe, jis par dil aaye woh yak-lakht maujud ho jaati hai. Sharab-e-Tohur ke chhalakte huye jaam ek dusre ko pila rahe hain, jis ke peene se suroor aur kaif, lutf aur bahaar hasil hoti hai, lekin bad-zubani behuda-goi nahi hoti, hizyan nahi bakte, behosh nahi hote. Sacha suroor aur poori khushi hasil, bak-jhak se dur, gunah se ghafil, baatil-o-kizb se dur, gheebat-o-gunah se nafoor. 

Duniya mein sharabiyon ki halat dekhi hogi ke un ke sar mein chakkar, pet mein dard, aql zail, bakwaas bahut, bu buri, chehre be-ronaq. Isi tarah sharab ke bad-zaiqa aur badbu. Yahan jannat ki sharab in tamam gandiyon se koso dur hai, yeh rang mein safed, peene mein khush-zaiqa, na is ke peene se hawas muattal ho, na bak-jhak ho, na bahein, na bhatke, na masti ho, na aur kisi tarah zarar pohnchaye. Hasi khushi is pak sharab ke jaam pila rahe honge. 

Un ke ghulam kamsan, nau-umar bachche jo husn-o-khobi mein aise hain jaise marwarid hon aur woh bhi dabbe mein band rakhe gaye hon, kisi ka hath bhi na laga ho aur abhi abhi taaze taaze nikale hon. Un ki aab-dari, safai, chamak-damak, roop-rang ka kya poochna? Lekin in ghulman ke haseen chehre unhe bhi maand kar dete hain. Aur jagah yeh mazmoon in alfaaz mein ada kiya gaya hai aayat: (Yatoofu 'alaihim wildanun mukhalladoon - 17).

(Al-Waqi'ah: 17) Ya'ni hamesha nau-umar aur kam-sin rehne wale bachche, aab-khore, aaftab-e aur aisi sharab-e saf ke jaam ke jin ke pine se na sar mein dard ho na behkein, aur jis qisam ka mewa yeh pasand karein aur jis parind ka gosht yeh chahein un ke paas baar baar laane ke liye charon taraf kamar-basta chal rahe hain. Is daur-e sharab ke waqt aapas mein ghul-mil kar tarah tarah ki baatein karein ge, duniya ke ahwal yaad aayein ge, kahenge ke hum duniya mein jab apne walon mein the to apne Rab ke aaj ke din ke azab se sakht larzan-o-tarsan the. Alhamdulillah, Rab ne hum par khas ehsaan kiya aur hamare khauf ki cheez se humein amn diya, hum usi se duayein aur iltijaein karte rahe us ne hamari duayein qabul farmaen aur hamara qaul poora kar diya, yaqinan woh bahut hi nek suluk aur raham wala hai. 

Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Jannati apne doston se milna chahega to udhar dost ke dil mein bhi yehi khwahish paida hogi, us ka takht udega aur raste mein dono mil jayenge, apne apne takhton par aaram se baithe hue baatein karne lagenge, duniya ke zikr ko chhedenge aur kahenge ke flan din flan jagah hum ne apni bakhshish ki dua mangi thi, Allah ne use qabul farmaya. Is hadis ki sanad kamzor hai. 

Hazrat Ma'isha [Aisha] R.A ne jab is aayat ki tilawat ki to yeh dua padhi: Allahumma min 'alayna wa qina 'azab as-samoom innaka antal-barrur-raheem. 
Hazrat A'mash rawi-e-hadis se poochha gaya ke is aayat ko padh kar yeh dua Umm-ul-Mu'mineen ne namaz mein mangi thi? Jawab diya: Haan.)

Kahin Ki Pehchan

Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ko hukum deta hai ke Allah ki risalat Allah ke bandon tak pohchate rahein saath hi badkaron ne jo bohtan aap par bandh rakhe the un se aap ki safayi karta hai. Kahin usay kehte hain jis ke paas kabhi kabhi koi khabar jinn pohcha deta hai, to irshad hua ke deen-e-haq ki tabligh kijiye. Alhamdulillah aap na to jinnat wale hain na junoon wale.

Phir kafiron ka qoul naqal farmata hai ke yeh kehte hain ke An-Hazrat ﷺ aik shair hain unhein kehne do jo keh rahe hain, un ke intiqal ke baad un ki si kaun kahega? Un ka yeh deen un ke saath hi fana ho jayega. Phir apne Nabi ﷺ ko is ka jawab dene ko farmata hai ke acha udhar tum intezar karte ho udhar main bhi muntazir hoon, duniya dekh legi ke anjam-e-kar ghalba aur ghair-fani kamyabi kisay hasil hoti hai?

Dar-un-Nadwa mein Quresh ka mashwara hua ke Muhammad ﷺ bhi misl aur shairon ke aik shair-go hain unhein qaid kar lo wahin yeh halak ho jayenge jis tarah Zuhair aur Nabigha shairon ka hashar hua. Is par yeh aaytein utrin.

Phir farmata hai kya un ki danayi unhein yahi samjhati hai ke bawajood janne ke phir bhi teri nisbat ghalat afwahin udayein aur bohtan bazi karein? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh bare sarkash gumrah aur inaad rakhne wale log hain, dushmani mein aa kar waqiyat se chashm-poshi kar ke aap ko muft mein bura bhala kehte hain.

Kya yeh kehte hain ke is Quran ko Muhammad ﷺ ne khud aap bana liya hai? Fi-waqia aisa to nahi lekin un ka kufr un ke munh se yeh ghalat aur jhoot baat nikalwa raha hai. Agar yeh sache hain to phir yeh khud bhi mil jul kar hi aik aisi baat bana kar dikha dein. Yeh kuffar-e-Quresh to kya? Agar un ke saath rooye zameen ke jinnat-o-insan mil jayein jab bhi is Quran ki nazir se woh sab aajiz rahenge aur poora Quran to bari cheez hai is jaisi das sortein balkay aik sorat bhi qayamat tak bana kar nahi la sakte.

Tauhid-e-Rububiyyat aur Uluhiyyat  
Tauhid-e-Rububiyyat aur Tauhid-e-Uluhiyyat ka sabut diya ja raha hai, farmata hai: Kya yeh baghair maujid ke maujud ho gaye? Ya yeh khud apne maujid aap hi hain? Darasal dono baatein nahi balki inka khaliq Allah Ta'ala hai, yeh kuch na the Allah Ta'ala ne inhein paida kar diya. 

Hazrat Jubair bin Mut'im R.H farmate hain: Nabi ﷺ Maghrib ki namaz mein Surah At-Tur ki tilawat kar rahe the, main kaan lagaye sun raha tha jab aap ayat (AM 'INDAHUM KHAZAINU RABBIKA AM HUMUL-MUSAYTIRUN) (At-Tur: 37) tak pahunche toh meri halat ho gayi ke goya mera dil uda ja raha hai (Bukhari). Badri qaidiyein mein hi yeh Jubair aaye the, yeh us waqt ka waqia hai jab yeh kafir the, Quran Pak ki in aayaton ka sunna inke liye Islam ka zariya ban gaya. 

Phir farmata hai ke kya asman-o-zamin ke paida karne wale yeh hain? Yeh bhi nahi balki yeh jante hue ke khud inka aur kul makhluqat ka banane wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai, phir bhi yeh apne beyqini se baaz nahi aate. 

Phir farmata hai: Kya duniya mein tasarruf inka hai? Kya har cheez ke khazano ke malik yeh hain? Ya makhluq ke muhasib yeh hain? Haqeeqat mein aisa nahi balki malik-o-mutasarruf sirf Allah Azzawajal hi hai, woh qadir hai jo chahe kar guzre. 

Phir farmata hai: Kya unche asmano tak chadh jane ka koi zeena inke pas hai? Agar yun hai toh inmein se jo wahan pahunch kar kalam sun aata hai, woh apne aqwal-o-afaal ki koi asmani daleel pesh kare, lekin na woh pesh kar sakta hai na woh kisi haqaniyat ke paband hain. 

Yeh bhi inki badi bhari galti hai ke kehte hain farishte Allah ki ladkiyan hain. Kya maze ki baat hai ke apne liye toh ladkiyan naapasand hain aur Allah Ta'ala ke liye sabit karein? Inhein agar malum ho jaye ke inke yahan ladki hui toh gham ke mare chehra siyah pad jaye aur Allah Ta'ala ke muqarrab farishton ko iski ladkiyan batayein, itna hi nahi balki inki parastish karein. 

Pas nihayat dant-dapat ke sath farmata hai: Kya Allah ki ladkiyan hain aur tumhare ladke hain? 

Phir farmaya: Kya tu apni tabligh par inse kuch muawza talab karta hai jo inpar bhari pade? Yaani Nabi Allah Deen Allah ke pahunchane par kisi se koi ujrat nahi mangte, phir inhein yeh pahunchana kyun bhari padta hai? 

Kya yeh log ghaib-dan hain? Nahi balki zamin-o-asman ki tamam makhluq mein se koi bhi ghaib ki baatein nahi janta. Kya yeh log Deen Allah aur Rasool Allah ki nisbat bakwaas kar ke khud Rasool ko, momino ko aur aam logon ko dhoka dena chahte hain? Yaad rakho, yahi dhoke-baaz dhoke mein reh jayenge aur ukhrawi azab sametenge. 

Phir farmaya: Kya Allah ke siwa inke aur mabud hain? Allah ki ibadat mein buton ko aur dusri cheezon ko yeh kyun sharik karte hain? Allah toh shirkat se mubra, shirk se pak aur mushrikon ke is fael se sakht bezar hai.

Kya yeh log ghaib-dan hain? Nahi balki zamin-o-asman ki tamam makhluq mein se koi bhi ghaib ki baatein nahi janta. Kya yeh log Deen Allah aur Rasool Allah ki nisbat bakwaas kar ke khud Rasool ko, momino ko aur aam logon ko dhoka dena chahte hain? Yaad rakho, yahi dhoke-baaz dhoke mein reh jayenge aur ukhrawi azab sametenge. 

Phir farmaya: Kya Allah ke siwa inke aur mabud hain? Allah ki ibadat mein buton ko aur dusri cheezon ko yeh kyun sharik karte hain? Allah toh shirkat se mubra, shirk se pak aur mushrikon ke is fael se sakht bezar hai.

Tauhid-e-Rububiyyat aur Uluhiyyat  
Tauhid-e-Rububiyyat aur Tauhid-e-Uluhiyyat ka sabut diya ja raha hai, farmata hai: Kya yeh baghair maujid ke maujud ho gaye? Ya yeh khud apne maujid aap hi hain? Darasal dono baatein nahi balki inka khaliq Allah Ta'ala hai, yeh kuch na the Allah Ta'ala ne inhein paida kar diya. 

Hazrat Jubair bin Mut'im R.H farmate hain: Nabi ﷺ Maghrib ki namaz mein Surah At-Tur ki tilawat kar rahe the, main kaan lagaye sun raha tha jab aap ayat (AM 'INDAHUM KHAZAINU RABBIKA AM HUMUL-MUSAYTIRUN) (At-Tur: 37) tak pahunche toh meri halat ho gayi ke goya mera dil uda ja raha hai (Bukhari). Badri qaidiyein mein hi yeh Jubair aaye the, yeh us waqt ka waqia hai jab yeh kafir the, Quran Pak ki in aayaton ka sunna inke liye Islam ka zariya ban gaya. 

Phir farmata hai ke kya asman-o-zamin ke paida karne wale yeh hain? Yeh bhi nahi balki yeh jante hue ke khud inka aur kul makhluqat ka banane wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai, phir bhi yeh apne beyqini se baaz nahi aate. 

Phir farmata hai: Kya duniya mein tasarruf inka hai? Kya har cheez ke khazano ke malik yeh hain? Ya makhluq ke muhasib yeh hain? Haqeeqat mein aisa nahi balki malik-o-mutasarruf sirf Allah Azzawajal hi hai, woh qadir hai jo chahe kar guzre. 

Phir farmata hai: Kya unche asmano tak chadh jane ka koi zeena inke pas hai? Agar yun hai toh inmein se jo wahan pahunch kar kalam sun aata hai, woh apne aqwal-o-afaal ki koi asmani daleel pesh kare, lekin na woh pesh kar sakta hai na woh kisi haqaniyat ke paband hain. 

Yeh bhi inki badi bhari galti hai ke kehte hain farishte Allah ki ladkiyan hain. Kya maze ki baat hai ke apne liye toh ladkiyan naapasand hain aur Allah Ta'ala ke liye sabit karein? Inhein agar malum ho jaye ke inke yahan ladki hui toh gham ke mare chehra siyah pad jaye aur Allah Ta'ala ke muqarrab farishton ko iski ladkiyan batayein, itna hi nahi balki inki parastish karein.

Taye shuda badnaseeb aur nishast-o-barkhast ke aadab. Mushrikeen aur kafiron ke inaad ka bayaan ho raha hai ki yeh apni sarkashi, zidd aur hatdharmi mein is qadr barh gaye hain ki Allah ke azab ko mehsoos kar lene ke baad bhi unhe iman ki taufiq na hogi. Yeh agar dekh lenge ki aasmaan ka koi tukra Allah ka azab ban kar un ke saron par gir raha hai toh bhi unhe tasdeeq-o-yaqeen na hoga balki saaf keh denge ki ghaleez abr hai jo paani barasane ko aa raha hai. Jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa lau fatahna ‘alaihim baban minas-sama’i fazallu fihi ya’rujun) (Surah Al-Hijr: 14-15), agar hum un ke liye aasmaan ka koi darwaza bhi khol dein aur yeh wahan charh jayein tab bhi yeh toh yehi kahenge ki hamari aankhein baandh di gayi hain balki hum par jadoo kar diya gaya hai. Yaani mojizaat jo yeh talab kar rahe hain agar un ki chahat ke mutabiq hi dikha diye jayein balki khud unhe aasmaanon par charha diya jaye jab bhi yeh koi baat bana kar taal denge aur iman na layenge. Ae Nabi ﷺ aap unhe chor dijiye, qayamat wale din khud unhe maloom ho jayega, us din un ki saari fareb-kariyan dhari ki dhari reh jayengi, koi makari wahan kaam na degi, chokri bhool jayenge aur chalaki bhool jayenge. Aaj jin jin ko yeh pukarte hain aur apna madadgar jaante hain, us din sab ke munh takenge aur koi na hoga jo un ki zara si bhi madad kar sake balki un ki taraf se kuch uzr bhi pesh kar sake. Yehi nahi ki unhe sirf qayamat ke din hi azab ho aur yahan itminan-o-aram ke sath zindagi guzaar lein balki un na-insafon ke liye is se pehle duniya mein bhi azab tayar hain. Jaise aur jagah farman hai aayat (Wa lanuziqqannahum minal-'azabil-adna dunal-'azabil-akbari la'allahum yarji'un) (Surah (As-Sajdah: 21) yaani hum unhe akhirat ke bare azab ke alawa duniya mein bhi azab ka maza chakhayenge taaki yeh ruju karein lekin un mein se aksar be-ilm hain, nahi jaante ki yeh duniyawi museebaton mein bhi mubtala honge aur Allah ki na-farmaniyan rang layengi. Yehi be-ilmi hai jo unhe is baat par amada karti hai ki gunah par gunah, zulm par zulm karte jayein, pakre jaate hain, ibrat hasil hoti hai lekin jahan pakar hati yeh phir waise ke waise sakht dil bad-kaar ban gaye. Baaz ahadees mein hai ki munafiq ki misaal oont ki si hai jis tarah oont nahi jaanta ki use kyun baandha aur kyun khola? Isi tarah munafiq bhi nahi jaanta ki kyun bimar kiya gaya? Aur kyun tandrust kar diya gaya? Asar-e-Ilahi mein hai ki main kitni ek teri na-farmaniyan karunga aur tu mujhe saza na dega? Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ae mere bande kitni martaba maine tujhe aafiyat di aur tujhe ilm bhi na hua.

Phir farmata hai ke aye Nabi ﷺ aap sabr kijiye un ki izaa-dahi se tang dil na hojaiye un ki taraf se koi khatra bhi dil mein na laiye suniye aap hamari hifazat mein hain aap hamari ankhon ke samne hain aap ki nigahbani ke zimma-dar hum hain tamam dushmanon se aap ko bachana hamare supurd hai phir hukm deta hai ke jab aap khare hon to Allah Ta'ala ki paki aur tareef bayan kijiye is ka ek matlab yeh kiya gaya hai ke jab raat ko jagen dono matlab durust hain chunache ek hadith mein hai ke namaz ko shuru karte hi An-Hazrat ﷺ farmate hain dua (Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika wa tabaraka ismuka wa ta'ala jaduka wa la ilaha ghairuk) Sahih Muslim. Yani aye Allah tu pak hai tamam tareefon ka mustahiq hai tera naam barkaton wala hai teri buzurgi bahut buland-o-bala hai tere siza mabood-e-barhaq koi aur nahi Musnad Ahmad aur Sunan mein bhi Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh kehna marwi hai Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs raat ko jage aur kahe dua (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadeir. Subhanallahi wal-hamdu lillahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah) phir khwah apne liye bakhshish ki dua kare khwah jo chahe talab kare Allah Ta'ala us ki dua qubool farmata hai phir agar us ne pukhta irada kiya aur wazu kar ke namaz bhi ada ki to woh namaz qubul ki jati hai. Yeh حدیث Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein aur Sunan mein bhi hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain Allah ki tasbeeh aur hamd ke bayan karne ka hukm har majlis se khare hone ke waqt hai Hazrat Abul Ahwas ka qaul bhi yahi hai ke jab majlis se uthna chahe yeh parhe dua (Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik) Hazrat Ata bin Abu Rabah bhi yahi farmate hain aur farmate hain ke agar us majlis mein neki hui hai to woh aur barh jati hai aur agar kuch aur hua hai to yeh kalma us ka kaffara hojata hai Jami' Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ne An-Hazrat ﷺ ko taleem di ke jab kabhi kisi majlis se khare ho to dua (Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaika) parho. Is ke rawi Hazrat Mu'ammar farmate hain main ne yeh bhi suna hai ke yeh qaul us majlis ka kaffara hojata hai. Yeh hadith to mursal hai lekin musnad hadeethein bhi is bare mein bahut si marwi hain jin ki sanadein ek dusri ko taqwiyat pohanchati hain ek hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi majlis mein baithe wahan kuch bak-jhak ho aur khare hone se pehle in kalmat ko keh le to us majlis mein jo kuch hua hai us ka kaffara hojata hai (Tirmidhi). Is hadith ko Imam Tirmidhi Hasan Sahih kehte hain.

Imam Hakim isay Mustadrak mein riwayat kar ke farmatay hain is ki sanad shart-e-Muslim par hai haan Imam Bukhari ne is mein illat nikali hai, mein kehta hoon Imam Ahmad, Imam Muslim, Imam Abu Hatim, Imam Abu Zur'ah, Imam Darqutni waghera ne bhi isay ma'lool kaha hai aur wehm ki nisbat Ibn Juraij se hai hi nahi, aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ apni akhri umr mein jis majlis se kharay hotay in kalmaat ko kehtay, balkay aik shakhs ne poochha bhi ke Huzoor ﷺ aap is se pehle to isay nahi kehte thay? Aap ne farmaya majlis mein jo kuch hua ho yeh kalmaat is ka kaffara hojatay hain, yeh riwayat mursal sanad se bhi Hazrat Abul Aliyah se marwi hai wallahu a'lam Nasai waghera. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr farmatay hain yeh kalmaat aisay hain ke jo inhein majlis se uthtay waqt teen martaba keh lay is ke liye yeh kaffara hojatay hain, majlis-e-khair aur majlis-e-zikr mein inhein kehne se yeh misl-e-mohar ke hojatay hain (Abu Dawood waghera). Alhamdulillah mein ne aik alag juz mein an tamam ahadeekh ko, un ke alfaaz ko aur un ki sanadon ko jama kar diya hai aur un ki illatein bhi bayaan kar di hain aur is ke mutalliq jo kuch likhna tha likh diya hai. 

Phir irshad hota hai ke raat ke waqt is ki yaad aur is ki ibadat tilawat aur namaz ke sath kertay raho jaise farmaan hai: Ayat (وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهٖ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ ڰ عَسٰٓي اَنْ يَّبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُوْدًا 79؀) 17-Al-Isra:79 (Raat ke waqt tahajjud parha karo yeh teray liye nafal hai mumkin hai tera Rab tujhe Maqam-e-Mahmood par uthaye). Sitaron ke doobne ke waqt se murad subh ki farz namaz se pehle ki do raqatein hain ke woh dono sitaron ke ghuroob honay ke liye jhuk janay ke waqt parhi jati hain, chunancha aik marfoo hadith mein hai in sunnaton ko nah choro go tumhein ghoray kuchal dalen. Isi hadith mein hai din raat mein paanch namazen hain sunnay walay ne kaha kya mujh par is ke siwa aur kuch bhi hai? Aap ne farmaya nahi magar yeh ke tu nafal ada karay. Bukhari o Muslim mein Hazrat Ayesha se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ nawafil mein se kisi nafal ki ba-nisbat subh ki do sunnaton ki ziyada pabandi kertay thay, aur yeh do raqatein dunya aur jo kuch is mein hai us se behtar hain. Alhamdulillah Surah At-Tur ki tafseer poori hui.)

Yani aye Allah tu pak hai tamam tareefon ka mustahiq hai tera naam barkaton wala hai teri buzurgi bahut buland-o-bala hai tere siza mabood-e-barhaq koi aur nahi Musnad Ahmad aur Sunan mein bhi Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh kehna marwi hai Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs raat ko jage aur kahe dua (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadeir. Subhanallahi wal-hamdu lillahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah) phir khwah apne liye bakhshish ki dua kare khwah jo chahe talab kare Allah Ta'ala us ki dua qubool farmata hai phir agar us ne pukhta irada kiya aur wazu kar ke namaz bhi ada ki to woh namaz qubul ki jati hai. Yeh حدیث Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein aur Sunan mein bhi hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain Allah ki tasbeeh aur hamd ke bayan karne ka hukm har majlis se khare hone ke waqt hai Hazrat Abul Ahwas ka qaul bhi yahi hai ke jab majlis se uthna chahe yeh parhe dua (Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik) Hazrat Ata bin Abu Rabah bhi yahi farmate hain aur farmate hain ke agar us majlis mein neki hui hai to woh aur barh jati hai aur agar kuch aur hua hai to yeh kalma us ka kaffara hojata hai Jami' Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) ne An-Hazrat ﷺ ko taleem di ke jab kabhi kisi majlis se khare ho to dua (Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaika) parho. Is ke rawi Hazrat Mu'ammar farmate hain main ne yeh bhi suna hai ke yeh qaul us majlis ka kaffara hojata hai. Yeh hadith to mursal hai lekin musnad hadeethein bhi is bare mein bahut si marwi hain jin ki sanadein ek dusri ko taqwiyat pohanchati hain ek hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi majlis mein baithe wahan kuch bak-jhak ho aur khare hone se pehle in kalmat ko keh le to us majlis mein jo kuch hua hai us ka kaffara hojata hai (Tirmidhi). Is hadith ko Imam Tirmidhi Hasan Sahih kehte hain.

Imam Hakim isay Mustadrak mein riwayat kar ke farmatay hain is ki sanad shart-e-Muslim par hai haan Imam Bukhari ne is mein illat nikali hai, mein kehta hoon Imam Ahmad, Imam Muslim, Imam Abu Hatim, Imam Abu Zur'ah, Imam Darqutni waghera ne bhi isay ma'lool kaha hai aur wehm ki nisbat Ibn Juraij se hai hi nahi, aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ apni akhri umr mein jis majlis se kharay hotay in kalmaat ko kehtay, balkay aik shakhs ne poochha bhi ke Huzoor ﷺ aap is se pehle to isay nahi kehte thay? Aap ne farmaya majlis mein jo kuch hua ho yeh kalmaat is ka kaffara hojatay hain, yeh riwayat mursal sanad se bhi Hazrat Abul Aliyah se marwi hai wallahu a'lam Nasai waghera. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr farmatay hain yeh kalmaat aisay hain ke jo inhein majlis se uthtay waqt teen martaba keh lay is ke liye yeh kaffara hojatay hain, majlis-e-khair aur majlis-e-zikr mein inhein kehne se yeh misl-e-mohar ke hojatay hain (Abu Dawood waghera). Alhamdulillah mein ne aik alag juz mein an tamam ahadeekh ko, un ke alfaaz ko aur un ki sanadon ko jama kar diya hai aur un ki illatein bhi bayaan kar di hain aur is ke mutalliq jo kuch likhna tha likh diya hai. 

Phir irshad hota hai ke raat ke waqt is ki yaad aur is ki ibadat tilawat aur namaz ke sath kertay raho jaise farmaan hai: Ayat (وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهٖ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ ڰ عَسٰٓي اَنْ يَّبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُوْدًا 79؀) 17-Al-Isra:79 (Raat ke waqt tahajjud parha karo yeh teray liye nafal hai mumkin hai tera Rab tujhe Maqam-e-Mahmood par uthaye). Sitaron ke doobne ke waqt se murad subh ki farz namaz se pehle ki do raqatein hain ke woh dono sitaron ke ghuroob honay ke liye jhuk janay ke waqt parhi jati hain, chunancha aik marfoo hadith mein hai in sunnaton ko nah choro go tumhein ghoray kuchal dalen. Isi hadith mein hai din raat mein paanch namazen hain sunnay walay ne kaha kya mujh par is ke siwa aur kuch bhi hai? Aap ne farmaya nahi magar yeh ke tu nafal ada karay. Bukhari o Muslim mein Hazrat Ayesha se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ nawafil mein se kisi nafal ki ba-nisbat subh ki do sunnaton ki ziyada pabandi kertay thay, aur yeh do raqatein dunya aur jo kuch is mein hai us se behtar hain. Alhamdulillah Surah At-Tur ki tafseer poori hui.)

Taye shuda badnaseeb aur nishast-o-barkhast ke aadab. Mushrikeen aur kafiron ke inaad ka bayaan ho raha hai ki yeh apni sarkashi, zidd aur hatdharmi mein is qadr barh gaye hain ki Allah ke azab ko mehsoos kar lene ke baad bhi unhe iman ki taufiq na hogi. Yeh agar dekh lenge ki aasmaan ka koi tukra Allah ka azab ban kar un ke saron par gir raha hai toh bhi unhe tasdeeq-o-yaqeen na hoga balki saaf keh denge ki ghaleez abr hai jo paani barasane ko aa raha hai. Jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa lau fatahna ‘alaihim baban minas-sama’i fazallu fihi ya’rujun) (Surah Al-Hijr: 14-15), agar hum un ke liye aasmaan ka koi darwaza bhi khol dein aur yeh wahan charh jayein tab bhi yeh toh yehi kahenge ki hamari aankhein baandh di gayi hain balki hum par jadoo kar diya gaya hai. Aaj jin jin ko yeh pukarte hain aur apna madadgar jaante hain, us din sab ke munh takenge aur koi na hoga jo un ki zara si bhi madad kar sake balki un ki taraf se kuch uzr bhi pesh kar sake. Yehi nahi ki unhe sirf qayamat ke din hi azab ho aur yahan itminan-o-aram ke sath zindagi guzaar lein balki un na-insafon ke liye is se pehle duniya mein bhi azab tayar hain. Yehi be-ilmi hai jo unhe is baat par amada karti hai ki gunah par gunah, zulm par zulm karte jayein, pakre jaate hain, ibrat hasil hoti hai lekin jahan pakar hati yeh phir waise ke waise sakht dil bad-kaar ban gaye. Aur kyun tandrust kar diya gaya? Asar-e-Ilahi mein hai ki main kitni ek teri na-farmaniyan karunga aur tu mujhe saza na dega?
